products.title: Systematically Attacking From Top Pins: Mount by Gordon Ryan
products.body:
Learn How To Break Down Your Opponents From The Mount With This Total Technical Guide To Controlling & Submitting Systematically With Dynamic Pinning Lessons From The Best No-Gi Grappler On Earth, 3-Time ADCC Champion Gordon “The King” Ryan

  • Control the mount against all your opponent’s escapes and begin to isolate limbs away from the body for strangles and joint locks
  • Maintain the mount against escapes with Gordon’s advice on shutting down their defenses and taking advantage with counters
  • Gordon teaches you every detail of his system across 8-volumes so that you can start attacking with more technique and confidence
  • Watch Gordon spar in live rounds from mount, then break down his techniques so you can see the system in action
  • This top pinning system is the same one that Gordon has used to dominate at the elite levels of no-gi grappling, with his coach John Danaher’s revolutionary concepts & dilemmas
  • Know more. Win more!


Secure Submissions With Systematic Success, With Instruction On Armbars, Triangles, And More!

 

Check Out Sample!

What Will You Learn?

Join the best no-gi grappler on Earth as Gordon “The King” Ryan shows you how to systematically attack from the mounted position with eight volumes of dynamic pinning lessons that grapplers of all levels can use. Hunt submissions as you isolate limbs and hold mount against their escapes with Gordon’s techniques for grappling mastery.

Use armbars, triangles, and more submission systems that Gordon has developed with his coach Professor John Danaher, and has been able to use against the best grapplers in the world. These joint locks and strangles can help increase your finishing percentage, you can become a technical force from the mount.

Watch live rounds from the gym as Gordon spars from mount and then breaks down the footage so you can see his system in action, from his point of view. Shut down escapes and counter for better position and stronger controls so you can always maintain your pin.

Gordon Ryan is the best no-gi grappler in the world today, and he is back with BJJ Fanatics to show you his game, broken down so grapplers of all levels can understand and benefit. Get this top pins series today and begin holding down tough opponents and finding serious submissions with more confidence and skill.

products.body:
Create more submission attacks and control from top with Gordon Ryan’s guide to side control and north south offense

  • Use kimuras, triangles, juji gatame, and more in systematic fashion as Gordon shows you how to isolate and submit limbs
  • Shut down escapes so you can constantly stay in control with Gordon’s keys to maintenance
  • Watch Gordon break down gym footage to talk you through the techniques and system in real-time
  • This top pinning system is the same one that Gordon has used to dominate at the elite levels of no-gi grappling, with his coach John Danaher’s revolutionary concepts & dilemmas
  • Know more. Win more.

Relentlessly Attack Submissions & Improve Position From Side Control & North South With Gordon “The King” Ryan’s 8-Part Masterclass Series On How To Systematically Dominate These Pinning Positions In No-Gi Grappling

 

Check Out Sample!

What Will You Learn?

Attack from top pins with the best no-gi grappler on Earth, as Gordon Ryan shows you how to properly and systematically break through your opponents escapes and defenses for side control and north south mastery. On this 8-volume series, you’ll learn the same techniques and strategies Gordon uses, including live rolling footage so you can see the moves in action.

Pinning from top, especially in no-gi, can be really tricky, but now Gordon can explain to you to get real control, shut down escapes, begin isolating limbs, and hunt for the tap. Use some of his most effective submission systems and dilemmas, including kimura, various forms of triangle, juji gatame armbar, and more, each taught in extreme detail.

Prevent your opponent from getting away with Gordon’s advice on side control and north south maintenance, including how, why, and when to transition from one to the other. With six volumes packed with technique, Gordon also shows from live sparring rounds in the gym how he puts the system into action as he narrates and breaks down each exchange for you.

Gordon Ryan is the best no-gi grappler in the world today, and he is back with BJJ Fanatics to show you his game, broken down so grapplers of all levels can understand and benefit. products.title: Systematically Attacking Triangles by Gordon Ryan

Revolutionize Your Ability To Attack and Finish With The Most Effective Triangle Variations, Under The Guidance Of Grappling GOAT Gordon Ryan!
  • Gordon Ryan teaches you to systematically attack the triangle and its many variations in his masterclass 8-part instructional spanning hours of Triangle content, coupled together with rolling footage and commentary!
  • Master all aspects of the triangle including distinct breakdowns of the front triangle, side triangle, reverse triangle, wrong way triangle, and the back triangle.
  • Learn to land triangles from a wide range of positions and scenarios including seated guard, supine guard, from passing, from pins, and more!
  • Discover perfect finishing mechanics that Gordon has refined throughout his legendary career, as well as inside details of real-world examples from Gordon’s matches.
  • Dominate opponents with 5 high-percentage submissions from the back triangle, one of Gordon’s most used variations of the triangle!
  • Watch Gordon put the system to work with rolling footage and hear him explain his methodology in the commentary section of the instructional.
